marking.criterion: Elementwise: intensity about 0.3-2 FLOP/B, far below the 295 FLOP/B ridge, so time is set by bytes and GB/s vs 3.35 TB/s is the figure of merit
Large GEMM: intensity in the thousands, far above the ridge, so time is set by FLOPs and TFLOP/s vs 989 TFLOP/s is the figure of merit

title: GB/s for elementwise, TFLOP/s for GEMM
